column1: # These procs sit at 4-aligned absolute addresses but inside gap sections that
# START at 2/3-mod-4 offsets, so an in-place typed `struct ProcCmd[]` (4-aligned)
# would insert a pad byte and shift the ROM tail. The fix: pin each proc cluster to
# its OWN standalone `.gapN_procs` section at its exact 4-aligned address, with the
# sub-word leading pad kept in a 1-aligned `.gapN_head` section. Drop the baseline
# .set definitions so the linker uses the carved typed definitions.
